title: Public Safety Analysis
key_finding: The city says BSO is the primary law-enforcement authority within Deerfield Beach, the city has contracted with BSO for law-enforcement services since 1990, and a 24-month implementation period effective October 1, 2025 keeps BSO providing services while the city transitions.

title: Police Services Contract 2021-2026
key_finding: The city approved a five-year BSO police-services agreement commencing April 1, 2021 and continuing through March 31, 2026, after earlier Deerfield-BSO police contracts.

title: The Future of Public Safety in Deerfield Beach
key_finding: On December 22, 2025, the city announced it would not renew the BSO contract and would build its own police department, but also stated that BSO remains contractually and legally obligated to continue providing full service during a nearly two-year transition.

title: County and Municipal Offense Report 2020A
key_finding: FDLE's 2020 county-and-municipal offense report lists Deerfield Beach Police Department with population 80,178 and total index crime 1,888.

title: County and Municipal Offense Report 2021A
key_finding: FDLE's 2021 county-and-municipal offense report retains Deerfield Beach Police Department as a named municipal row with population 87,106 but all offense cells blank.

title: FIBRS Offense Detail 2021-2025 Q2 workbook
key_finding: Inspection of the official FDLE FIBRS offense workbook found no Deerfield Beach Police Department row in the 2021, 2022, 2023, 2024, or 2025 Q2 sheets.
